item.title: Goal 987! Ronaldo opens the scoring from the spot against Al-Sadd — 13 to go
item.description:
🔥 Brought down in the box, Cristiano Ronaldo converted the penalty himself in the 13th minute against Al-Sadd in the AFC Champions League Elite. It is his 987th career goal, and his 17th in the competition for Al Nassr, one more than Abderrazak Hamdallah, the club's previous record holder. He had missed two penalties earlier this season. Only 13 goals to go.
#CR7 #Ronaldo #AlSadd #Football #To1000
